description: This file implements a PostHog integration for logging analytics events related to Large Language Models (LLMs). It defines a class PostHogLogger that manages batching and sending of events to PostHog, including asynchronous and synchronous methods, credential handling, and batch flushing on exit.

classes.name: PostHogLogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending LLM analytics events to PostHog, supporting batching, asynchronous and synchronous event logging, and automatic flushing on program exit.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PostHogLogger, checks environment variables, sets up HTTP clients, and registers exit handler.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Sends a successful event synchronously to PostHog.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event to PostHog.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed event to PostHog.

methods.name: _log_async_event
methods.description: Internal method to enqueue an event for asynchronous batch sending.

methods.name: create_posthog_event_payload
methods.description: Creates a PostHog event payload from request kwargs.

methods.name: _create_posthog_properties
methods.description: Generates properties for a PostHog event following LLM analytics standards.

methods.name: _add_trace_properties
methods.description: Adds trace-related properties to event payload.

methods.name: _add_custom_metadata_properties
methods.description: Adds custom metadata fields to event properties.

methods.name: _get_distinct_id
methods.description: Determines a unique identifier for the event, based on metadata or UUID.

methods.name: _get_credentials_for_request
methods.description: Retrieves API credentials and URL for the request, considering per-request overrides.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Sends queued events in batch asynchronously to PostHog.

methods.name: _ensure_async_setup
methods.description: Initializes asynchronous components if not already set up.

methods.name: _create_posthog_payload
methods.description: Creates a payload dictionary for batch sending.

methods.name: _safe_get
methods.description: Safely retrieves a value from a dictionary or object.

methods.name: _flush_on_exit
methods.description: Flushes remaining queued events synchronously when the program exits.
